mechanics.name: Power Struggle
mechanics.currentEffect: While in the Dying State, reveals the Auras of upright Pallets. Once you reach 25/20/15% Wiggle progression while being carried by the Killer, you can drop a nearby Pallet; it stuns the Killer and makes them release you. The perk deactivates after use.
activation: Be in the Dying State to see upright Pallet Auras.
While being carried, reach the tier-specific Wiggle progression threshold and have a nearby upright Pallet.
Ends/deactivates when: Deactivates after dropping a Pallet with the perk.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (5.5.0): Lowered the Wiggle threshold from 35/30/25% to 25/20/15% and added Aura reading for upright Pallets while in the Dying State.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: While downed and carried, it shows upright Pallets and lets you drop one to stun the Killer after enough wiggle progress.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Deactivates after use; no separate per-Trial count is stated.
specialInteractions: Flip-Flop can convert Recovery progression into Wiggle progression, which can contribute toward the threshold.

editorial.summary: Once your wiggle progress reaches the threshold while being carried, you can drop a nearby upright Pallet yourself and stun the Killer into releasing you.
useCases: Create a self-save when the Killer carries you through an upright pallet.
Pair with Flip-Flop so ground recovery preloads the wiggle threshold.
Use pallet Aura information while downed to position for a possible escape.
counters: Requires the Killer to carry you through a usable upright Pallet.
Threshold must be reached before passing the pallet.
pros: Can directly free you from the Killer's grasp.
cons: Often needs another perk to become reliable.
analysis: Power Struggle ranks this position because escaping the Killer's grasp is one of the biggest individual swings available from a perk, but the setup is demanding. You need sufficient wiggle progress and an upright pallet exactly where the carry path passes.

Flip-Flop is the classic partner because ground recovery can pre-convert into wiggle progress, allowing Power Struggle to activate much earlier after pickup. Tenacity and Unbreakable help create the same recovery-oriented shell.
Without that support, the Killer will often reach a hook before the threshold or simply avoid carrying through obvious pallets. Experienced Killers recognize the setup and can path around it.
The ceiling is excellent and the floor is very low. Power Struggle belongs in B as a build-defining anti-carry option, not a perk you can blindly equip for consistent value.
editorial.verdict: A spectacular self-save perk trapped behind geometry and setup. Power Struggle is excellent in its dedicated build and unreliable everywhere else.

archetypeRatings.note: The combination creates a much higher coordinated ceiling than Power Struggle has as a generic standalone perk.
